entry.external_evidence: Not yet in durable storage. Renders and boards were made in the build session and can be regenerated from tools/catalogue_crescent_terrace_pilot.
limitations: Fixed native assembly of the whole crescent, 126 m by 48 m; no resizing, no repeated houses, and no single-house version.
The catalogue lists a 6 m by 12 m plot for this archetype; this model needs a plot of at least 130 m by 52 m.
Thirty-six doors at grade; which one is the plot's entrance is undecided. The sunken areas of the real building type are left out.

The roof-plan reference shows a different, shorter building. On 2026-11-18 a person accepted the street view and the oblique as the plan authority for this variant; the roof-plan image informs roof character only.
Terrain fit, entrance routing and every runtime gate are untested; see tools/catalogue_crescent_terrace_pilot/integration/runtime-review.md.

Remaining review notes, none blocking: corner capitals show a scroll end to each end elevation, end-bay windows sit tight between the columns, door reveals have no floor, dormers have no attic, and column shafts are twelve-sided.
The independent review is by an AI reviewer, not a person.

picker.description: Eighteen-house Georgian crescent in Bath stone with a giant Ionic order, balustrade and slate roofs.
picker.reshape_description: Move and rotate the complete crescent. It keeps its authored size.

human_decisions.decision: The street view (variant_0.png) and the oblique (variant_0_angle_60.jpg) are the plan authority for london-crescent-terrace-bath-stone. The roof-plan image (variant_0_angle_90.jpg) informs roof character only and is not replaced.
human_decisions.answers: independent-review-v006.json, for_human_acceptance item 1 (P2-10; Gate A and clay profile condition 1)
human_decisions.context: Reply to the builder recommending that the street view and oblique be accepted as plan authority rather than replacing the roof-plan image.
human_decisions.grants: This settles the source question only. It is not keeper approval, runtime activation or publication.
